messages:
sarah-support: FYI billing ping — trial acct acct_12345 noticed ~118k trial credits gone overnight, customer escalated.

oliver-sre: seeing API spike around 2026-02-18T03:12Z. lots of embedding requests that show 401 then rapid retries then eventual 200s. looks like a retry storm.

sarah-support: source appears to be the scheduled job `nightly-vectorize` using a service account key.

ben-eng: can you paste a short log excerpt?

sarah-support: pasted logs from the worker below:
```
[2026-02-18T03:12:01Z] worker=vecsync id=job-87654 embedding failed status=401 msg=\"token expired\"
[2026-02-18T03:12:01Z] retry attempt=1
[2026-02-18T03:12:07Z] worker=vecsync id=job-87654 embedding failed status=401 msg=\"token expired\"
[2026-02-18T03:12:08Z] retry attempt=2
[2026-02-18T03:12:15Z] worker=vecsync id=job-87654 embedding request status=200 tokens=512
[2026-02-18T03:12:15Z] result=ok
```

oliver-sre: those patterns line up with a transient auth rotation (401s) while the worker re-sends requests quickly. worker has no idempotency header, so each retry produced a charge.

ben-eng: reproduced locally by forcing a 401 mid-flight then letting retry loop run — we see duplicated embedding calls for same job id. root cause: token refresh race + aggressive retry/backoff.

oliver-sre: immediate mitigation suggestions:
- pause `nightly-vectorize` (infra)
- revoke the rotated key and issue a fresh one
- patch worker to attach `Idempotency-Key: <job-id>` and cap retries to 2 with exponential backoff
- ask billing to queue a trial credit reversal for acct_12345

billing-eng: I can do a reversal for the trial credits. Need account id, exact time window, and a few sample request/job ids to validate. Also will flag the promo so it doesn't auto-drain again.

sarah-support: acct id=acct_12345, time window=2026-02-18T03:00:00Z - 2026-02-18T04:30:00Z. sample job ids: job-87654, job-87655. I'll attach full log slices in the ticket.

ben-eng: quick code patch prepared to add idempotency header and reduce retries. snippet for the worker:
```
fetch(\"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings\", {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Authorization': `Bearer ${API_KEY}`,
    'Idempotency-Key': jobId
  },
  body: payload
})
```

oliver-sre: we'll also add a server-side guard: dedupe identical embedding requests with same Idempotency-Key for 60s. prevents double billing if clients retry too fast.

infra-bot: cron `nightly-vectorize` disabled by infra at 2026-02-18T04:05:12Z :snowflake:

ben-eng: patch deployed to staging, running canary, then will promote to prod once dedupe metric looks good.

billing-eng: starting reversal process now for acct_12345. ETA 2 business days for trial credit refund. If customer needs instant relief we can issue a temporary promo credit — ping me.

oliver-sre: owners clarified: infra -> pause job & rotate key, ben-eng -> patch & canary, billing-eng -> credits/reversal, sarah-support -> customer comms + collect logs. Follow-up check-in at 2026-02-18T15:00Z.

sarah-support: updated the customer: \"we paused background processing and are reversing the consumed trial credits. we'll follow up after the fix is live.\" :white_check_mark:

ben-eng: additional follow-ups: add rate limit for worker to 10r/s and add exponential jitter to backoff.

sarah-support: thanks all — I'll keep this thread updated with the billing ticket ID once created.
